description: Cover sheet: 3D rendered exterior perspective of a small single-story contemporary Thai house — dark brown hip roof with deep overhangs on a slender post-supported carport, white plaster walls with a grey stone-veneer entry column, full-height sliding glass door + curtained windows at the entry facade, a man walking toward the entry, a red hatchback parked under the carport, landscaped garden (tree, palms, shrubs, flowering plants, decorative rocks), and a hazy city skyline silhouette in the background. Blue banner strips top (title text) and bottom (project name + ministry seal + room-count callout). No structural or quantity data on this page — a marketing/cover render only.
warnings: op1 direct read (house 08). Same series template as house 01's หน้า01 (บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย, กรมโยธาธิการและผังเมือง) but a different design number (6, not 1) and a different render (hip roof + red car vs. house 01's skillion roof + yellow car) — read independently from this house's own image, not copied.
